subtitle: Manage governed documents and repository sources used for FDAI knowledge.
sourcesHint: Open a source to upload content or review its connection boundary. Credentials and repository authorization remain in Integration settings.
documentsSummary: Upload files through quarantine, protection checks, extraction, and indexing.
githubSummary: Prepare a governed GitHub repository connection and define its synchronization scope.
gitlabSummary: Prepare a governed GitLab project connection and define its synchronization scope.
azureDevopsSummary: Prepare a governed Azure DevOps repository connection and define its synchronization scope.
connectorSubtitle: Review the governed connection boundary for {provider} knowledge.
connectorUnavailableBody: This deployment does not expose a server-owned {provider} connector contract yet. No repository content has been synchronized or indexed from this source.
connectorBoundary: Repository credentials, organization access, path scope, synchronization policy, and secret storage must be configured through a server-owned integration. The browser never stores provider credentials.
unsupportedFileFormat: This file format is not supported. Use PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, a supported text file, or a supported image.
legacyOfficeFormat: Legacy DOC, PPT, and XLS files are not supported. Save them as DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, or PDF first.
readyWithWarnings: Ready with processing warnings. Review the document metadata before relying on image-derived content.
formatSignatureMismatch: The file content does not match its filename extension or media type.
malformedPackage: The Office or PDF package is malformed and could not be processed safely.
ocrUnavailable: OCR is required for this document, but the configured OCR provider is unavailable.
noExtractableContent: No cited text could be extracted from this document.
encryptedDocument: This encrypted or protected document cannot be read with the current authorization.
ocrUnavailableHint: Image-only uploads are unavailable because OCR is not configured. Images embedded in Office documents are reported as processing warnings.
viewPurpose: A source-oriented view of governed knowledge intake without inferring unobserved connection state.
connectorViewPurpose: The explicit {provider} knowledge-source boundary and its current setup availability.
